# Hanayen Abaya Factory

> Hanayen Abaya Factory is the manufacturing base of Hanayen, a Dubai modest-fashion house founded in 1990 that produces abayas, sheilas and jalabiyas for customers across the Gulf. The building stands in Al Qusais Industrial Area, one of Dubai's established light-industrial districts, and brings the brand's cutting, tailoring, embroidery and finishing operations together with its head office on a single site.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Al Qusais, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Hanayen Abaya Factory is the manufacturing facility of Hanayen, a Dubai-based producer and retailer of abayas, sheilas and modest wear founded in 1990. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the factory building, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services for the facility.
